## Boundary checklist

This is a public repository (docs/PUBLIC_REPO_BOUNDARY.md). Tick each line or explain below why it does not apply.

- [ ] No secret values, tokens or credentials; no node names, IPs, tunnel ids or secret-store paths.
- [ ] No prices, quotes or client identities; no raw links into MADFAM's private ops repository.
- [ ] No platform code: this PR adds or changes cartridges (or this repository's own docs and CI).

## Cartridge checklist (one agent, one slug)

- [ ] `<slug>/main.py`, `<slug>/project.json`, `<slug>/docs/README.md`; strict kebab-case slug; no licence file in the cartridge.
- [ ] `project.attribution.license` and `hyperobject.commons_license` both `CERN-OHL-W-2.0`.
- [ ] `project.attribution.lineage[]` filled (empty only for original work); heritage objects cite sources and credit their community.
- [ ] Labels and the article's title and summary in en, es, fr and pt, written or reviewed by a person.
- [ ] Geometry generated by `main.py`; no copied designer crease pattern or diagram.
- [ ] `pliego-spec check cartridge <slug>` output pasted below (zero FAIL); the generator run with defaults and one non-default parameter.
- [ ] No index edited (the coordinator claims indexes when landing a passing cartridge).
